224:t_1:3.en: ～ Inside the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ ～

224:t_1:6.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry, Big Bro... I finally got to see you again like this, at the center of the galaxy, and yet I...」

224:t_1:7.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Don't worry about it, $$ランカ$$. Besides... I have no right to call myself your brother.」

224:t_1:8.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「You are $$ランカ・リー$$... Your only family is your brother, $$オズマ・リー$$.」

224:t_1:10.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Right now you're lost in fear and anxiety... But you should know how to shake it off.」

224:t_1:12.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「And don't forget. No matter how deep in despair you are, there are people who love you...」

224:t_1:13.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「And that their feelings saved me, who was struggling in the darkness.」

224:t_1:15.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Let me hear your song again...」

224:t_1:16.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Thinking of someone... saves you, too...」

224:t_1:18.en:
$$シェリル$$
「...Feeling a little calmer, $$ランカ$$-chan?」

224:t_1:19.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry, $$シェリル$$... I keep causing you so much trouble.」

224:t_1:20.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Don't worry about it. Being thrown out to a place like this so suddenly was a shock to me, too.」

224:t_1:21.en:
$$シェリル$$
「But when you think about it, we've just gone back to where we started. We were really at the center of the galaxy, and from there we got sent flying to Earth.」

224:t_1:22.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Now that you mention it, that's true...」

224:t_1:23.en:
$$シェリル$$
「...I think a lot of things come down to attitude. Wherever we are, the thing we have to do is the same.」

224:t_1:24.en:
$$ランカ$$
(What I have to do... It's...)

224:t_1:25.en:
$$ランカ$$
(But the way I am now...)

224:t_1:30.en:
$$マックス$$
「...I've heard most of the story from my daughter... from $$ミレーヌ$$. First of all, let me welcome you all.」

224:t_1:31.en:
$$マックス$$
「I am $$マクシミリアン・ジーナス$$, commander of the Escort Fleet of the 37th Super Long-Range Emigrant Fleet, $$マクロス７$$. I also serve as captain of this $$バトル７$$.」

224:t_1:32.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I am Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$ of the $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, from the 55th Super Long-Range Emigrant Fleet, $$マクロスフロンティア$$. It is an honor to meet the legendary captain.」

224:t_1:33.en:
$$マックス$$
「By a prank of spacetime, I happen to exist in the same time as you. Being called a legend makes me a little embarrassed.」

224:t_1:34.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You are too modest. Your exploits in the 《$$バロータ戦役$$》 are told and retold throughout all the fleets.」

224:t_1:35.en:
$$オットー$$
(So that's $$ミレーヌ$$'s father, Captain $$マックス$$...)

224:t_1:36.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(It's amazing that he's over fifty, looking like that...)

224:t_1:37.en:
$$ブライト$$
(But if we're talking about surprises, the Chief of Staff over there is another.)

224:t_1:38.en:
$$オットー$$
(A $$ゼントラーディ$$ who stays giant all the time...)

224:t_1:39.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Now then, without further delay, allow me to offer my conjecture on how you were transferred to a region of space so close to ours.」

224:t_1:40.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「But first, an introduction. I am $$エキセドル・フォルモ$$, Chief of Staff of the Escort Fleet of the $$マクロス７船団$$.」

224:t_1:41.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「As you can see, I am a $$ゼントラーディ$$.」

224:t_1:42.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I, too, have heard of your exploits since the 《$$第一次星間大戦$$》.」

224:t_1:43.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Not at all... I have lived as a records officer, yet the world still holds no end of surprises.」

224:t_1:44.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「And so it is with your transfer this time.」

224:t_1:45.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What do you mean by that?」

224:t_1:46.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「First of all, the ultra-long-range transfer from Earth to this region at the galaxy's center can only be called a mystery of the universe.」

224:t_1:47.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「With no dimensional faults or energy loss, there is no past example of anyone artificially succeeding at a fold of such ultra-long range.」

224:t_1:48.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Yet the fact is, it happened. This must truly be called a mystery of the universe.」

224:t_1:49.en:
$$ブライト$$
「A mystery of the universe...」

224:t_1:50.en:
$$オットー$$
「We've gotten caught up in something outrageous, haven't we...」

224:t_1:51.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Chief of Staff $$エキセドル$$... Is the $$時空震動|lc$$ we encountered on Earth related to this transfer?」

224:t_1:52.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「I do not grasp the whole situation, but that $$時空震動|lc$$ was, so to speak, the entrance.」

224:t_1:53.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「As I said earlier, how that entrance came to connect to the center of the galaxy lies in a realm beyond human understanding.」

224:t_1:54.en:
$$オットー$$
「Still, in this vast universe, to meet people we know like this is a miracle upon a miracle.」

224:t_1:55.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「However, that is no miracle. It is the work of a certain kind of power... and a human power at that.」

224:t_1:57.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「The exit of your transfer... that is, your return to normal space very near us, was due to the power of $$熱気バサラ$$.」

224:t_1:60.en:
$$マックス$$
「Actually... around the same time you transferred into this region...」

224:t_1:61.en:
$$マックス$$
「A tribute live for $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ was being held in the $$マクロス７船団$$.」

224:t_1:62.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「The feelings of the people packed in there for $$熱気バサラ$$... and $$バサラ$$'s song answering them... The two fused, and that is how you came here.」

224:t_1:63.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Can such a thing really happen...」

224:t_1:64.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「The songs of $$熱気バサラ$$ have the power to interfere with even dimensions.」

224:t_1:65.en:
$$マックス$$
「The researchers of our fleet named that power $$歌エネルギー$$ and were pressing ahead with research, but...」

224:t_1:66.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's him all right. I can guess he hated becoming a research subject.」

224:t_1:67.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And then you were caught in a $$時空震動|lc$$ and transferred to Earth, so the research must have been forced to halt, too.」

224:t_1:68.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Just as you say. ...However, in the meantime we continued our research on the $$プロトデビルン$$ he drove back.」

224:t_1:69.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The 《$$プロトデビルン$$》... the race that was collecting $$スピリチア$$, which could be called biological energy, right?」

224:t_1:70.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「That's right. ...In the world we come from, the race said to have made Earth's humanity intelligent, the 《$$プロトカルチャー$$》...」

224:t_1:71.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「They spread widely through the universe, but gradually split into two factions and came to fight each other.」

224:t_1:72.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「The combat race used in that war was the 《$$ゼントラーディ$$》.」

224:t_1:73.en:
$$ブライト$$
(So they were a kind of biological weapon...)

224:t_1:74.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「The $$プロトカルチャー$$ that made the 《$$ゼントラーディ$$》 went on to build their superior, the 《$$エビル・シリーズ$$》.」

224:t_1:75.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Energy life forms that came flying from the $$サブ・ユニバース$$, a universe of another dimension, possessed those Evil and became the $$プロトデビルン$$.」

224:t_1:76.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「To exist, the $$プロトデビルン$$ needed the biological energy of other living things, $$スピリチア$$, and the $$プロトカルチャー$$ became their target, too...」

224:t_1:77.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「As a result, the $$プロトカルチャー$$ were driven to extinction by them.」

224:t_1:78.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I hear that in the $$バロータ戦役$$, the $$プロトデビルン$$, revived after tens of thousands of years, were sealed away again by the song of $$熱気バサラ$$.」

224:t_1:79.en:
$$マックス$$
「Out of fear of various repercussions, it is generally held that the $$バロータ戦役$$ ended that way, but the truth is different.」

224:t_1:80.en:
$$マックス$$
「Through the song of $$熱気バサラ$$, the $$プロトデビルン$$ were reborn as a race that renews its own $$スピリチア$$, and no longer needed the $$スピリチア$$ of other living things.」

224:t_1:82.en:
$$マックス$$
「Exactly. With that, the war between the $$プロトデビルン$$ and humanity ended, and they went off to somewhere unknown.」

224:t_1:83.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「But much about them remains a mystery, such as how the energy life forms possessed the Evil. Repeated investigation into it made me face a terrifying fact.」

224:t_1:85.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「The fact of the universe's collapse on a 12,000-year cycle.」
